about: The trainer AI knows New Gold's Irrigation swallows a Water move (flag 0, trainer_ai_script.c 29FA). Falkner's Hoothoot is taught Water Gun and Leer once the battle is up and faces a Sudowoodo, whose only ability here is Irrigation, that only Splashes: it Leers every turn of six. Before the fix Water Gun, twice effective on a Rock-type, was rated as a hit and used once the Sudowoodo's Defense was down four stages, which raised its Attack two stages. Leer and Splash are given 30 PP, so neither runs out.
